statements.checked: n≥3, algebraically closed char p>0, ample L; all integers r≥r0; geometric generic tuple; exact ordinary multipoint constant. Remark 6.3 p16 gives n=2.
A,B,a_i>0; graded family; d=max(3/A,2/B); dw<1/16; cardinalities, gradedness, backward jets preserved.
n≥2; every r≥r0 and every 0<theta<(V/r)^(1/n); every sufficiently large N; special tuple may depend on N, geometric generic tuple fixed.

proofPassages.scope: Lemmas 2.2–2.6, finite weight realization, formal truncated-ring transfer, compression including characteristic-p gaps.
Proposition 3.1 complete-intersection flag, lex least exponents, global divisibility and degree bound.
Entire proof of Proposition 4.1, Hensel two branches including p=2, primitive lattice direction and slice compression.
Lemmas 5.1–5.2 and Proposition 5.3, counting decompositions, CRT, interior translation and geometric generic base change.
Lemmas 6.1–6.2 and proof of Theorem 1.1, local lengths, blow-up multiplicity, volume bound, n=2.
